name: three-globe
notes: 2026-11-15: Triage reason: Assess compatibility with frame-driven Three.js scenes and determine whether time-based layer animation can be controlled. Revisit when globe scenes are in scope.
2026-11-15: Legacy schema value used for a listed-only candidate; this is not evidence of PRD inclusion.
summary: Three.js object for spherical geographic visualisation with data layers for points, arcs, polygons, paths, heatmaps, tiles, labels and custom objects. Configure layer data through JavaScript accessors; it is a scene component, not a standalone renderer.
use_when: Add globe layers for arcs, points, polygons, paths, heatmaps or labels to a Three.js scene
Drive a geographic globe as one component in a larger Three.js composition
avoid_when: Use deck.gl when the main task is large scale 2D geospatial data visualisation
Use MapLibre GL JS for interactive maps with tiled basemaps rather than a globe scene

assessment.last_release: Release date not found on reviewed releases page
assessment.rationale: README documents a Three.js class, numerous geographic layers and explicit pause/resume controls. It fits frame-driven Three.js scenes, while transition helpers require deterministic-time review.
